execution_note: No case was executed in this audit. This file defines future remediation regressions and policy characterization, not measured failures or passing evidence.

adapter_contract.entry_construction: Convert synthetic_vocabulary_entries into the current VocabularyEntry/Alias or public Store API according to the case. Do not skip public admission tests by using direct dataclasses. ScopeContext keys are current domain keys.
adapter_contract.stateful_cases: Use current real application helpers and declared portable shims where native imports require them. Report mocked-interface versus native separately.
adapter_contract.snippet_cases: Resolve current valid trigger/registry APIs and record concrete spans before execution; the invariant cases deliberately do not invent constructor signatures.
adapter_contract.exact_oracles: When expected_text is set, compare exact Unicode strings and exact vocabulary edit populations/IDs; otherwise implement the stated independent invariant. No substring-only or nonempty-output pass.
adapter_contract.policy_cases: CHARACTERIZATION and REQUIRES_ADJUDICATION are not automatic bugs; preserve declared limitations unless a documented policy change is chosen.
adapter_contract.synchronization: Use latches/barriers or ordered acknowledgements, not sleep-based race proofs.

exposure.instruction: Track families used for repair tuning. A final new withheld family may be authored by the independent reviewer; this supplied corpus is not blind.

findings.title: A multiword alias can consume a clause delimiter
A failed refresh can reuse another job’s scoped dictionary
Canonical no-op shielding is order-dependent and permits second-pass drift
VocabularySnapshot is not deeply immutable after its revision is computed
HintSet content can change without changing hint_set_id
Vocabulary read-modify-write validation occurs outside the writer transaction
Malformed boolean values are coerced into approval
Panel selection can retarget an approval after filtering or refresh
Dictionary skill edits lose the approving vocabulary entry identity
An unsorted alias list makes repeated import non-idempotent
Repeated identities within one import can leave a partially applied file
Alias language metadata is not preserved by all public transitions
Sandbox and conflict diagnostics do not fully mirror live scope/ownership
Hint retention failure is recorded as ordinary non-capture
Historical approving-rule reconstruction is not independently demonstrated
The normalization benchmark can pass a matcher that performs no vocabulary work
Current live-scope, privacy and race oracles are thinner than the connected system
Torn-table repair is tested on an empty vocabulary, not surviving user state
The future qualified-adapter test proves shape, not qualification identity
Some active M05-facing descriptions still describe pre-M06/pre-M07 consumers
